description: Read a signed-in athlete's static biometric profile (bodyweight, height, sex, primary modality, training phase), race goals, and active pain regions without session history or workload math. Use for quick biometric or race-date lookups; when prescribing workouts or assessing fatigue, use `get_coaching_brief` instead. Requires OAuth 2.1 or `read`-scoped Bearer token.

focus.description: Concise 1-sentence summary of what the athlete is asking in this turn (e.g. 'building a 4-day powerlifting block', 'checking squat progression', 'auditing weekly back volume') so STRUGGL ranks relevant athlete memories and context.

name: get_profile

profile.description: Athlete bodyweight, height, sex, modality, and phase fields.
